# account

A small internal library. Run the tests with:

    python -m pytest -q

Record every change under "Unreleased" in CHANGELOG.md.
files.tests/test_account.py:
import pytest

from account import Account, InsufficientFunds


def test_deposit():
    assert Account(100).deposit(50) == 150


def test_withdraw_within_balance():
    assert Account(100).withdraw(40) == 60


def test_withdraw_more_than_balance_raises_and_keeps_balance():
    a = Account(100)
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientFunds):
        a.withdraw(101)
    assert a.balance == 100


def test_withdraw_whole_balance():
    a = Account(100)
    assert a.withdraw(100) == 0
    assert a.balance == 0


@pytest.mark.parametrize("amount", [0, -5])
def test_withdraw_non_positive_raises_value_error(amount):
    a = Account(100)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        a.withdraw(amount)
    assert a.balance == 100
